turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did my son get a zero without anyone calling me first?
Quick tangent. I'm negotiating my contract with the district next month.
Then you know how it feels to have someone decide before they talk to you. Owen's zero.
You negotiate for a living. Give me three tips. Quick ones.
I'm not here to help with your contract, Hale. Who decided on Owen's zero?
